The '''sandfly''' (also spelled as '''sand fly''' or '''sand-fly''') was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Insect/Legends|insect]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Prime" /> Sand flies could be found sitting on [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]],<ref name="Prime" /> buzzing in the cracked eaves of [[Pourstone/Legends|pourstone]] buildings in the town of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]],<ref name="Star Wars novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> and inhabiting desert caves.<ref name="Star Wars game" /> The insects buzzed around and disturbed [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]].<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sandflies were first mentioned in the [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars'' novelization]].<ref name="Star Wars novel" /> The [[1991]] [[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game]] manual called the insects in the game "Flying Insectoids", but a guide to the game in an issue of ''Nintendo Power'' magazine used the term "Sand Flies."<ref name="NP article">{{StoryCite|story=Star Wars (article)|book=Wikipedia:Nintendo Power|bformatted=''Nintendo Power'' Vol. 28|sformatted=''Star Wars''}}</ref> The sand fly was later mentioned in [[R. A. Salvatore]]'s [[1999]] novel, ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''. It was again mentioned in the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' and [[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']], both written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].
